explication: OrcaSlicer is desktop 3D-print preparation software. The principal workflow is to load a model, configure printer and process settings, slice it into layers and toolpaths, inspect the result, and export or send G-code to a printer. The README documents calibration, support generation, seam and wall controls, and network-printer compatibility. Sampled code also shows CAD geometry operations, a Python plugin manager and slicing-pipeline capability, and device-state parsing. Most core workflow implementation was not sampled, so those subsystem links reflect documented behavior rather than inspected call sites.
